# A synthetic console dump in the probe's u3 shape: a generation-D Pi 5 whose
# HVS was read (d_disp0's words are hvs6_dlist_mock.c's ctrl0 and status
# forms: enabled, RUN, 1920x1080, frcnt 5, yline 123), with one unity
# RGBA8888 list read TWICE, as main.c does:
# first in Z1 (two planes, the framebuffer the firmware left), then again
# after the probe's mailbox allocation (one plane, the new buffer, at a new
# address and a tight pitch). What decodes is the second read. The plane words
# are the put_plane form of driver/zephyr/lib/board/test/hvs6_dlist_mock.c.

rpi5_display: build test
rpi5_display: mailbox init 0
